title: x402 seller (plain TypeScript)
summary: Puts a small HTTP API behind x402 v2: each paid route answers 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED offer priced from config.json, refuses a payment for a different price, asset or payee with the reason, has a facilitator verify and settle an exact-scheme ERC-3009 payment, confirms the settlement through the Sato Kit's chain.read, and writes a discovery listing file that the builder submits. The seller holds no key. Fixture mode needs no network.

tests.description: The platform runs the fixture command (no network, no key, a fake facilitator, recorded chain reads) and checks out/report.json against schemas/output.json: an unpaid request gets 402 with an offer, the fixture payment gets 200 with a confirmed receipt, and a replay, an over-price, a wrong-asset and a tampered payment are each refused with their reason.
The template's own tests. Recorded, never the verdict.

Nightly in satohubai/sato-agent-templates: an anvil fork of Base at block 51800000; the fixture payment settled through the payment gate by transferWithAuthorization on the fork, confirmed through the kit's chain.read, the payee balance up by exactly the price, and a replay refused.

Weekly in satohubai/sato-agent-templates: against the public Base Sepolia RPC with no key, chain reads through the kit checked on contract constants and answer shapes (never on moving balances), plus this template's testnet answers. Never signs, never broadcasts.

provenance.notes: The x402 v2 wire format is written out in src/x402.ts rather than taken from a framework. Fork and testnet modes are opt-in and never run in the platform's offline test phase.
